description: This file implements a checkpoint transport mechanism for PyTorch distributed training, utilizing process groups to send and receive model state dictionaries, including support for tensors, DTensors, and ShardedTensors.

classes.name: _TensorMeta
classes.description: Metadata for a tensor used in checkpoint transfer, including shape, dtype, storage offset, stride, and size in bytes.

classes.name: _DTensorMeta
classes.description: Metadata for a DTensor, including local tensor metadata and tensor specification.

classes.name: _ShardedTensorMeta
classes.description: Metadata for a ShardedTensor, including local shard metadata and global tensor metadata.

classes.name: _StateDictMeta
classes.description: Metadata for a state dictionary used in checkpoint transfer, including the pytree structure, paths, and tensor/non-tensor leaves.

classes.name: PGTransport
classes.description: A class implementing checkpoint transfer over a process group, supporting sending and receiving model checkpoints efficiently.

methods.name: _timeit
methods.description: Context manager for timing code execution segments, logging duration.

methods.name: _prepare_tensor
methods.description: Prepares a tensor for serialization by casting to uint8 and collecting metadata.

methods.name: _prepare_state_dict
methods.description: Serializes a state dictionary, extracting tensors, DTensors, and ShardedTensors, and collecting their metadata.

methods.name: _cast_tensor
methods.description: Casts a tensor's storage to a specified dtype, ensuring storage consistency.

methods.name: send_checkpoint
methods.description: Serializes and sends a checkpoint (model state) to multiple destination ranks.

methods.name: recv_checkpoint
methods.description: Receives and reconstructs a checkpoint from a source rank, supporting tensors, DTensors, and ShardedTensors.
